mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 3% in the month preceding the prediction triggers a risk-off reaction, lowering equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.0% in the prior month
regime_hint: tightening phase of the Fed Funds rate
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or flat during the identified trigger, with p-value > 0.05 in a backtest.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (labor market strength) coincides with a decline in UNRATE (unemployment), signaling a tight labor market that suppresses equity valuations and drives negative 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases over the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive with a statistically significant positive IC (p < 0.05) in a rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST (residential construction) above 1.5% yoy suggests robust demand, which, when combined with low INDPRO (industrial production), predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) in the interaction regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO (industrial production) below 100 (baseline) combined with low GDPC1 (retail sales) indicates softening supply conditions, leading to a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates recovery.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or flat with IC < -0.1 in the interaction window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for three consecutive months during a low-inflation regime, it signals accommodative policy, associated with positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2.0% for three consecutive months and CPIAUCSL < 200 (inflation low)
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in PAYEMS above 140,000 (monthly) while UNRATE remains below 5%, indicates strong labor demand that pushes equity valuations higher over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 140,000 and UNRATE < 5.0% in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat with IC < -0.2 in the interaction regime.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in both INDPRO and RSAFS (retail sales) exceeding 2% signal supply-side weakness, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and RSAFS decline by >2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive with IC > 0.1 in the interaction regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 6% coincides with a sharp drop in HOUST (residential starts), indicating labor market dislocation and a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.0% while HOUST falls by >3% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the trigger.
